race.comment: SWIFT DUKE (6) has a solid record over this distance range with a win and a second from three attempts and will be cherry-ripe now third run back from the spell. Rider Peisley sticks in the saddle following that last-start placing and should be right there when the judge calls a halt. CITY GOLD FIELD (4) broke the maiden status at the Sunny Coast when resuming and will have derived a stack of confidence from that victory. Can go right on with the job now. LA PROFECIA (8) is a winner over this trip, draws the inside marble and gets the reliable Gollan/Lang combination. Ticks a few boxes for a race like this. ZALIQUE (9) returned in fine fashion with a strong Grafton win and has to be included in calculations. TEELG (2) next in line.
